metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Drishyam: The Conclusion
metas.description: Follows the Salgaonkar family as they try to cover up a murder.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2026 · Punjab '95
metas.description: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra takes on a broken system in a courageous fight to uncover the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings during the nadir of Punjab’s period of insurgency.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Dhurandhar: The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2026 · The Kerala Story 2 Goes Beyond
metas.description: Three young Indian women across different states choose love over tradition, only to become trapped. Their parallel lives show how romance and rebellion transform into control and silence, turning love into a weapon that destroys freedom.

metas.name: ★ 5.2 · 2026 · O' Romeo
metas.description: In post-independence Mumbai, the underworld rises amidst a changing city. This gritty tale explores the criminal landscape of a bygone era, weaving through the streets and shadows of India's bustling metropolis.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Assi
metas.description: When Parima, a school teacher in Delhi, is gang-raped on her way home late at night after an office party, Raavi, a prosecution lawyer, fights tooth and nail to help her get justice. But when eighty sexual assault cases are reported in India every single day, regardless of age group, ethnicity, time, or place,  and only four go to trial, what does justice really mean?

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2026 · Ikka
metas.description: A respected attorney must defend a murder suspect he previously brought down. Forced into the case, he bends every rule to secure freedom for his former enemy or risk losing all he cherishes.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · Daayra
metas.description: Raman, who has had a shady record with staged encounters and police brutality, finds himself cornered as Ajooni challenges him on every step.

metas.name: ★ 5.4 · 2026 · Kartavya
metas.description: A police officer faces a moral dilemma when threats endanger his family, forcing him to choose between protecting his loved ones and honoring his oath to serve justice.
